subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

In the midst of the tumult of charges against him, a **(welter)** of conflicting poll numbers are being bandied about.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Turmoil."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"welter" **means a large number of things in a confused or disordered state. (बड़ी संख्या में चीज़ें भ्रमित या अव्यवस्थित अवस्था में)

 
 
• **Example**: *There's such a **welter**__ of conflicting rules.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about charges against someone and conflicting poll numbers.
 
• The synonym for **"welter"** is **"turmoil."**
 
• **"Turmoil"** means a state of great disturbance or confusion. (शोरग़ुल या खलबली या अनिश्‍चितता की स्थिति)
 __
 
• **Example**: *His mind is in **turmoil**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, Static**, means something that is not moving or changing. (थमा हुआ, स्थिर (जिसमें कोई गति, परिवर्तन या विकास न हो रहा हो))
 
• **Option 2, Peace**, means a state of calm or tranquility. (ऐसी सि्‍थति या समयावधि जब किसी देश या प्रदेश में युद्घ या हिंसा न हो; शांति)
 
• **Option 3, Dynamic**, means something that is constantly changing or progressing. ((व्‍यक्ति) ऊर्जा तथा नाना प्रकार के विचारों से पूर्ण; सक्रिय, गतिशील)
